G45 reading (11), stated while ruling the restrict lines and logged before the lines it touches are written; it reads reading (1) and changes no ruling rule: a code in a submission carries the submission's hour in the coded record, though an edit added later carries it too. A code whose words show it is an edit or an update list (an 'Edit:' mark, a report that the work is done or that placement has ended, thanks to placers, a running list of instructions) cannot be dated by that hour, so it cannot be the first end named from the room's record.
